ideas.title: Uncovering the Truth Behind the Minnesota Shootings
ideas.description: Investigate the Minnesota shootings and the alleged withholding of evidence by the Trump administration.
ideas.angle: Follow the evidence and interview key witnesses to uncover the truth.
questions: Who is responsible for the withholding of evidence?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to reveal a significant cover-up and shed light on government accountability. By following the evidence and interviewing key witnesses, we can uncover the truth behind the Minnesota shootings.
